shortDescription: MPESB MSPSTET 2026 Rule Book for Primary and Secondary Teachers. Download the official PDF and verify the live application schedule on esb.mp.gov.in.
content:
The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has published the MSPSTET 2026 Rule Book for Teachers covering the Primary and Secondary Teacher Eligibility Test process.

The rule book is the controlling source for level-wise eligibility, syllabus, examination pattern, application instructions, important conditions and document requirements. Candidates should read the PDF before completing any application or preparing for the examination.

How to use the rule book

  1. Download the official PDF from the link below.
  2. Check the required educational qualification for the selected teacher level.
  3. Review the syllabus, examination scheme and application instructions.
  4. Use only the official MPESB portal for registration, fee payment and notices.
editorNotes: Independent listing for candidates. NaukriMitra is not a government website. Always open the official recruiting-body URL before paying a fee or relying on a result.
importantInstructions: Do not share login OTPs. Download PDFs only from the official domain. Dates and vacancy counts on aggregator sites can lag behind the notice.

faqs.question: Where can I download the MSPSTET 2026 Rule Book?
faqs.answer: Download the official rule book from the notification link on this page and confirm any later correction on https://esb.mp.gov.in.

faqs.question: What does the MSPSTET 2026 Rule Book contain?
faqs.answer: It contains the teacher eligibility requirements, syllabus, examination pattern, application instructions and other conditions for the notified process.

faqs.question: What should I keep ready?
faqs.answer: Photo, signature, educational certificates, category certificate (if any) and valid photo ID
